# The re-emission work queue: every M3-dir file (t/op mro uni lib test_pl) whose
# canon emission is unfaithful, at its first difference. A work list, not a register:
# it must be empty when m3-oracle-at-scale closes. Rows are
#   path:line class src canon prev reason
# with the cause (src canon prev) and class computed by TestFaithfulQueueMatchesTree.
# Regenerate with -parse.update-ratchet; never merge it by hand.

# causes heredoc = 0
# causes subless-special-sub = 0
# causes stmt-boundary = 0
# causes canon-adds-paren-op = 0
# causes canon-adds-paren-term = 0
# causes other = 0
